WITH serous AS ( SELECT idx, "Log2_variant_per_Mbp" AS log2v, "Case_excluded", "Proteomics_Tumor_Normal" FROM "1_s2_0_S0092867420301070_mmc1" WHERE "Histologic_type" = 'Serous' ) SELECT idx, log2v, "Case_excluded", "Proteomics_Tumor_Normal", POWER(2, log2v) AS variants_per_mbp FROM serous ORDER BY log2v

WITH serous AS ( SELECT POWER(2, "Log2_variant_per_Mbp") AS vpm, "Log2_variant_per_Mbp" AS log2v, "Case_excluded" FROM "1_s2_0_S0092867420301070_mmc1" WHERE "Histologic_type" = 'Serous' AND "Proteomics_Tumor_Normal" = 'Tumor' AND "Log2_variant_per_Mbp" IS NOT NULL ) SELECT ROUND(MEDIAN(vpm), 4) AS median_variants_per_mbp, ROUND(POWER(2, MEDIAN(log2v)), 4) AS median_via_log2_route, COUNT(*) AS n_samples, ROUND(MEDIAN(vpm) FILTER (WHERE "Case_excluded" = 'No'), 4) AS median_excluding_case_excluded_flag FROM serous
